Gives a wavelength of 2 m with unit

items.prompt: A sound wave in air travels at 340 m/s and vibrates at 170 Hz. Calculate its wavelength.

points.text: States v = f x wavelength and multiplies 5 by 3
Gives a speed of 15 m/s with unit

items.prompt: A wave has frequency 5 Hz and wavelength 3 m. Calculate its speed.

points.text: States work done = force x distance and multiplies 50 by 4
Gives work done of 200 J with unit

items.prompt: A force of 50 N pushes a crate 4 m in the direction of the force. Calculate the work done.

points.text: States power = work done / time and divides 200 by 2
Gives a power of 100 W with unit

items.prompt: The 200 J of work from the previous item is done in 2 s. Calculate the power.

levels.descriptor: Explanations chain wave and energy quantities to the answer in order, with each step justified by a named wave-equation, work or power rule.
levels.label: Secure

levels.descriptor: Explanations are broadly sound but one link between the quantities and the answer is asserted rather than justified.
levels.label: Developing

levels.descriptor: Answers state numbers or wave names without connecting them into an explanation.
levels.label: Beginning
